statement: Every model admitting the full subunit-power threshold path has an unbounded objective, hence no finite maximizer. The ambient model may include closed threshold contact and additional free parameters.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{P : Type*} {D : Set P} {L : P → ℝ}
    {d : Fin n → ℝ} (hd : ∀ i, 0 ≤ d i) (hz : ∃ i, d i = 0)
    {a b c s K : ℝ} (ha : a < 1) (hc : 0 < c) (hs : 0 < s) (path : ℝ → P)
    (hpath : ∀ t > 0, path t ∈ D ∧ L (path t) = logLik d a b c s K t) :
    ¬ BddAbove (L '' D) ∧ ¬ ∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p
dossier_scope_note: Transfers the interior spike to any ambient finite objective containing the path.

hypotheses_and_conclusion:

    (hd : ∀ i, 0 ≤ d i) (hz : ∃ i, d i = 0)
    (P C : Option ℝ) (hfree : P = none ∨ C = none)
    (hP : 0 < P.getD 1) (hC : 0 < C.getD 1) {q s : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hs : 0 < s) :
    ∀ M : ℝ, ∃ p q' c s' t : ℝ,
      0 < p ∧ P.getD p = p ∧ 0 < q' ∧ q' = q ∧ 0 < c ∧ C.getD c = c ∧
        s' = s ∧ 0 < t ∧ M < interiorLogLik d p q' c s' t

statement: For a constant positive excess, keep its scale and both beta shapes fixed. The ratio of every excess to the scale is one, so increasing the power adds exactly `n * log c` to the log likelihood.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
(hn : 0 < n) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (p q B : ℝ) :
    Tendsto
      (fun c ↦ logLik (fun _ : Fin n ↦ s) (c * p) (c * q) c s
        (log c - log s - B) 0)
      atTop atTop
dossier_scope_note: Kernel version of the fixed-shapes constant-excess ray.

statement: Along the joint scale and threshold ray `t = s`, a minimum contributes coefficient `-1` and a larger observation contributes `b` to the leading `log s` term. A negative sum gives divergence, including constant samples.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{d : Fin n → ℝ} (hd : ∀ i, 0 ≤ d i)
    {a b c K : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (hE : (∑ i, if d i = 0 then (-1 : ℝ) else b) < 0) :
    Tendsto (fun s ↦ logLik d a b c s (K - log s) s) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop
dossier_scope_note: Negative exponent E, on the positive gap-equals-scale ray.

statement: With scale and upper beta shape free, the simultaneous path `q = 1/T`, `s = t = exp(-T)` diverges with arbitrary fixed positive lower beta shape and power. Ties at the minimum contribute individually.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{d : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hd : ∀ i, 0 ≤ d i) (hz : ∃ i, d i = 0)
    {p c : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hc : 0 < c) :
    Tendsto (fun T ↦ interiorLogLik d p T⁻¹ c (exp (-T)) (exp (-T))) atTop atTop
dossier_scope_note: The exact free-scale and upper-shape ray with fixed lower shape and power.

statement: All structural free-threshold masks have unbounded likelihood and an empty finite maximizing set. This uses either a subunit lower power or the simultaneous vanishing upper-shape and scale path.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{d : Fin n → ℝ} (hd : ∀ i, 0 ≤ d i)
    (hz : ∃ i, d i = 0) (P Q C S : Option ℝ)
    (hP : 0 < P.getD 1) (hQ : 0 < Q.getD 1) (hC : 0 < C.getD 1) (hS : 0 < S.getD 1)
    (hfree : (P = none ∨ C = none) ∨ (Q = none ∧ S = none)) :
    let L := fun v : ThresholdParameters ↦
      interiorLogLik d v.lowerShape v.upperShape v.power v.scale v.gap
    ¬ BddAbove (L '' thresholdDomain P Q C S) ∧
      ¬ ∃ v ∈ thresholdDomain P Q C S, IsMaxOn L (thresholdDomain P Q C S) v
dossier_scope_note: Optional holds match the dossier after ordering lower shape, upper shape, power and scale.

    {A C : Set ℝ} (hA : p ∈ A) (hC : c ∈ C) :
    let D : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) := {v | (M < v.1 ∨ (v.1 = M ∧ v.2.2.1 = 1)) ∧

statement: When only the endpoint is free, a finite optimum exists exactly at upper shape at least one. At one it is closed contact. Above one the chart score characterizes the unique interior optimum.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
(hn : 0 < n) {x : Fin n → ℝ} {M p q c : ℝ}
    (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i) (hle : ∀ i, x i ≤ M) (heq : ∃ i, x i = M)
    (hp : 0 < p) (hc : 0 < c) :
    let D := if q = 1 then Ici M else Ioi M
    let L := fun b ↦ logLik x b p q c
    ((∃ b ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D b) ↔ 1 ≤ q) ∧
    (q = 1 → IsMaxOn L D M ∧ ∀ b ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D b → b = M) ∧
    (1 < q → ∃! b, b ∈ D ∧ IsMaxOn L D b)
dossier_scope_note: Includes constants and all upper contacts.

statement: At fixed upper shape above one, the unique endpoint optimum is the interior zero of the transformed score.

    (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 1 < q) (hc : 0 < c) (hb : M < b) :
    IsMaxOn (fun s ↦ logLik x s p q c) (Ioi M) b ↔

statement: At held scale and upper shape one, the full maximizing set is the product ridge. Constant interior samples satisfy the same formula.

statement: With threshold and scale fixed, attainment is exactly the branch with nonconstant positive excesses and an observation below scale.

statement: Held threshold and scale give the exact Pareto contact trace when all excesses reach scale and some exceed it. A constant excess at or below scale instead allows an unbounded fit.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
(hn : 0 < n) {x : Fin n → ℝ} {μ s : ℝ}
    (hx : ∀ i, μ < x i) (hs : 0 < s) :
    let D := BurrHeld.shapeDomain
    let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ ShapeFacesParetoIV.logLik x μ p.2 p.1 s / n
    let z := BurrHeld.logRatios (ShapeFacesParetoIV.excess x μ) s
    let B := BurrHeld.paretoValue z - BurrHeld.avg (fun i ↦ log (x i - μ))
    (((∀ i, s ≤ x i - μ) ∧ (∃ i, s < x i - μ)) →
      IsLUB (L '' D) B ∧ ∀ p ∈ D, L p < B) ∧
    ((∃ v, (∀ i, x i = v) ∧ v - μ ≤ s) → ¬ BddAbove (L '' D))
dossier_scope_note: Pareto value includes the contact penalty at excess equal to scale.

statement: With a held threshold, constants diverge. On nonconstant excesses, if the finite maximum fails to exist, the larger fitted Weibull and Pareto values give the strict, unattained supremum.

{x : Fin n → ℝ} {μ : ℝ}

    let f := fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ↦ ShapeFacesParetoIV.logLik x μ p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 / n
    let e := ShapeFacesParetoIV.excess x μ
